name: Audience chip
summary: One short tappable choice on the audience phone, several to a line: frosted deck surface, 44px touch floor, the deck font in its button, chosen in the deck accent.
highlights: Short tappable choice, several per line
Chosen state in the deck accent, aria-pressed
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-audience-chip> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css, so a build-less page imports it instead of copying CSS. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Chip
spec.value: min-height 44, padding 0 16, pill radius, 16px semibold label in the deck ink, frosted surface, 1px ink hairline

spec.label: Chosen
spec.value: a solid deck-accent pill; the label takes the contrast-picked accent ink
